items.title: Ask HN: Can we direct AI on our personal projects during work hours?
items.summary: So here's the question I wanted to pose around AI usage. With modern advanced AI, much of the time, using AI consists of sending a message a waiting a long time (often an hour or more) before the AI finishes a task. Which I think brings up an important question, is it okay to take short work breaks to send instructions to AI working on your personal projects during work hours? Do any employers have policies around this? And how does it interact with legal standards? Are the rules around work-product well suited to the modern AI age? Does it matter if I'm hourly vs salaried? Should we do the same thing for work (asking work AI to do things occasionally during personal time)? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49171630 Points: 2 # Comments: 1

items.title: Show HN: Blender for AI Agents
items.summary:
Creating 3D is hard. LLMs seem to be getting better at tool use and spatial understanding. While MCPs have proved to be a good way to use these tools- the current methods have these challenges: - Access to scene graph and core C modules of Blender - Lack of parallelism, only way is to run blender headless - Lack of deterministic and fast verification layer - Inference stack- only way to use inference is to hook another MCP We're building Mixar, think Cursor for 3D. One access point to all generative inference, an agent
to build scenes/blockouts, do boring stuff like UVs and export standard formats(.glb/gltf/obj/gbx/usd etc.) Try it: https://mixar.app - first week is free. Would love to get your feedback. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49171258 Points: 4 # Comments: 4
items.summary_html:
Creating 3D is hard. LLMs seem to be getting better at tool use and spatial understanding. While MCPs have proved to be a good way to use these tools- the current methods have these challenges:

- Access to scene graph and core C modules of Blender

- Lack of parallelism, only way is to run blender headless

- Lack of deterministic and fast verification layer

- Inference stack- only way to use inference is to hook another MCP

We're building Mixar, think Cursor for 3D. One access point to all generative inference, an agent to build scenes/blockouts, do boring stuff like UVs and export standard formats(.glb/gltf/obj/gbx/usd etc.)

Try it: https://mixar.app - first week is free. Would love to get your feedback.

Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49171258
